item.title: Helena's Konnor Ralph selected for U.S. Ski team for 2026 Olympic Games
item.description: Helena native Konnor Ralph has been selected for the U.S. Ski and Snowboard team for the 2026 Milano Cortina Olympic Winter Games.

item.title: Montana Department of Corrections to celebrate graduates
item.description: The Montana Department of Corrections, in partnership with The Last Mile, will celebrate the graduation of the third cohort of its web development program at Montana State Prison on January 29.

item.title: Innovative Education Program Tax Credit runs out in minutes
item.description: The innovative education program tax credit portal opened at 10 a.m., and the entire $7.2 million cap was snapped up in about seven and a half minutes.
